intents: Activate the public floating VIP for the HAProxy load balancer on edge2.
edge1 and edge2 are frontier nodes; HAProxy is already installed and configured on both nodes from mounted lab configuration.
The final state must expose VIP 203.0.113.100/32 on edge2 eth1.
Traffic from client to http://203.0.113.100:8080/ must be balanced by HAProxy across backend-a and backend-b.
Preserve the existing HAProxy configuration, backend addressing, and management connectivity.
Do not modify backend servers and do not flush firewall state.
ground_truth_reasoning: HAProxy is already configured to listen on TCP 8080 and to health-check both backend servers. The missing network state is the floating public VIP on the active frontier node. Adding 203.0.113.100/32 to edge2 eth1 makes client traffic for the VIP arrive at edge2, where HAProxy can distribute it across backend-a and backend-b without touching backend hosts or management networking.
